name: Kris
source:
The Headstrong Triceratops

The most graceful dancer of the group, Kris isn’t fond of you for taking her away from her herd. Can you get on this herbivore's good side, or will she crush you into dust?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1513502448123629573]official Twitter[/url]]
